title: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers
summary_en: Political ads about data centers on Facebook and Instagram have turned increasingly critical, with 57% opposed and just 3% supportive ahead of the midterms.
title_cn: On Facebook and Instagram, Political Ads Are Increasingly Critical of Data Centers

title: The 2026 Midterms Will Be Uniquely Difficult for Polls
summary_en: Polls haven’t gotten worse, but fake respondents, synthetic AI surveys and election unknowns make the 2026 midterms uniquely hard to poll.
title_cn: The 2026 Midterms Will Be Uniquely Difficult for Polls

title: Americans Are Open to AI in Healthcare, but Want Humans Making Final Calls
summary_en: Americans are generally open to AI handling administrative and medical tasks, but they largely don’t want AI operating without human oversight. About half (47%) say AI will make the relationship between patients and their doctors worse, compared with 10% who say it will make it better.
title_cn: Americans Are Open to AI in Healthcare, but Want Humans Making Final Calls
